name: Spanish guitar for a wedding ceremony: Can't Help Falling in Love
seoTitle: Spanish guitar for a ceremony: Can't Help Falling in Love
description: Can't Help Falling in Love on solo Spanish guitar, played live. It's a popular wedding processional, and Dirty Flamenco's guitarist would love to play it.
more: Traditional flamenco comes first on Dirty Flamenco's song list, and they play covers like Can't Help Falling in Love, too. At a wedding, the whole trio can play your prelude, processional and recessional, and move between Spanish pieces and the songs you ask for.
